title: The Twisted Ankle — Ottawa Rules, Ligament Tests and the High Ankle Sprain

hook.en: Most twisted ankles are sprains, but a few are fractures or high ankle sprains. Learn when to ask for an X-ray, how to test the ligaments and when to test them.
hook.ur: Zyada tar mure hue ankles sprain hote hain, lekin kuch fracture ya high ankle sprain. Seekhein ke X-ray kab maangna hai, ligaments kaise test karne hain aur kab.

goal.en: By the end, you'll apply the Ottawa ankle rules, perform the anterior drawer, talar tilt, squeeze and external rotation tests at the right time, and plan early loading and follow-up.
goal.ur: End tak aap Ottawa ankle rules lagayenge, sahi waqt par anterior drawer, talar tilt, squeeze aur external rotation tests karenge, aur shuruati loading aur follow-up ka plan banayenge.

text.en: Start by asking, **is it a fracture?** The **Ottawa ankle rules** are very sensitive: an X-ray is needed if there is pain near the ankle and **bone tenderness at the back edge or tip of either malleolus**, or the patient **cannot take four steps**; for the foot, tenderness at the **base of the fifth metatarsal** or the **navicular**. If none apply, a fracture is very unlikely, so you test the **ligaments**.
text.ur: Pehle poochhein, **kya yeh fracture hai?** **Ottawa ankle rules** bohat sensitive hain: agar ankle ke qareeb dard ho aur **kisi bhi malleolus ke peechay ke kinare ya nok par haddi ki tenderness** ho, ya patient **chaar qadam na le sake** to X-ray chahiye; pair ke liye **paanchve metatarsal ke base** ya **navicular** par tenderness. Agar koi nahi to fracture bohat kam mumkin hai, to aap **ligaments** test karte hain.

text.en: Think of the lateral ankle as a door held by three hinges: the front one (the **ATFL**) tears first when the foot rolls inwards, the middle one (the **CFL**) tears with more force, and the **syndesmosis** is the strap at the top that stops the two shin bones spreading. A rolled ankle usually tears the front hinge; a twist with the foot turned out may spring the strap.
text.ur: Ankle ki bahar ki side ko ek darwaze ki tarah sochein jo teen hinges par tika ho: agla hinge (**ATFL**) pair ke andar mudne par pehle phatta hai, darmiyani hinge (**CFL**) zyada force par, aur **syndesmosis** oopar ka patta hai jo do shin haddiyon ko alag hone se rokta hai. Mura hua ankle aam taur par agla hinge phaarta hai; pair bahar mur kar twist ho to patta khul sakta hai.

steps.title: Apply the Ottawa rules
steps.detail: Palpate the back edge and tip of both malleoli, the base of the fifth metatarsal and the navicular, and ask the patient to take four steps. Image if any is positive. || Ottawa rules lagayein

steps.title: Test the lateral ligaments
steps.detail: The anterior drawer tests the ATFL; the talar tilt tests the CFL. Compare with the other ankle. They are more accurate four to five days after the injury, when swelling and guarding have settled. || Lateral ligaments test karein

steps.title: Test the syndesmosis
steps.detail: Squeeze the tibia and fibula at mid-calf (pain at the ankle is positive) and turn the foot outwards (external rotation test). A positive result suggests a high ankle sprain, which heals more slowly. || Syndesmosis test karein

steps.title: Plan the loading
steps.detail: For a lateral sprain, protect briefly, then start early, comfortable loading and balance work; a high ankle sprain needs more protection. Review again if pain or swelling does not settle. || Loading ka plan banayein

question.en: After an inversion injury a patient has tenderness at the back edge of the lateral malleolus. What do the Ottawa rules say?
question.ur: Ankle mura hone ke baad lateral malleolus ke peechay ke kinare par tenderness hai. Ottawa rules kya kehte hain?

feedback.en: Yes — bone tenderness at the back edge or tip of a malleolus needs an X-ray.
feedback.ur: Haan — malleolus ke peechay ke kinare ya nok par haddi ki tenderness X-ray maangti hai.

text.ur: Imaging ke baghair foran loading shuru karein

feedback.en: A possible fracture must be excluded first.
feedback.ur: Pehle mumkin fracture exclude karna zaroori hai.

title.en: Lateral sprain or high ankle sprain?
title.ur: Lateral sprain ya high ankle sprain?

rows.en: Foot turns outwards with the leg twisting
rows.ur: Pair bahar mudta hai aur taang twist hoti hai

rows.en: Front and outer side of the ankle
rows.ur: Ankle ke aage aur bahar ki taraf

rows.en: Above the ankle, between the tibia and fibula
rows.ur: Ankle ke oopar, tibia aur fibula ke beech

rows.en: Often slower; may need more protection
rows.ur: Aksar dheere; zyada hifazat ki zaroorat

text.en: **Ottawa first, ligaments at day four.** Rule out a fracture before you test, and repeat the ligament tests four to five days later if the first examination was too painful.
text.ur: **Pehle Ottawa, ligaments chauthe din.** Test se pehle fracture rule out karein, aur agar pehli examination bohat dardnak thi to chaar paanch din baad ligament tests dohrayein.

text.en: **Squeezing and calling the pain at the calf positive.** In the squeeze test the pain must appear at the ankle, far from where you squeeze. Pain at the squeeze site is not a positive result.
text.ur: **Dabane ke baad pindli ke dard ko positive kehna.** Squeeze test mein dard ankle par hona chahiye, jahan aap dabate hain wahan se door. Dabane ki jagah ka dard positive result nahi.

question.en: Where must the pain be felt for the squeeze test to be positive?
question.ur: Squeeze test positive hone ke liye dard kahan hona chahiye?

feedback.en: Heel pain is not the sign.

text.en: At the place where the calf is squeezed

feedback.en: That is only the squeeze site.
feedback.ur: Yeh sirf dabane ki jagah hai.

text.en: At the ankle, between the tibia and fibula, away from the squeeze
text.ur: Ankle par, tibia aur fibula ke beech, dabane ki jagah se door

feedback.en: Yes — that is the sign of syndesmosis injury.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh syndesmosis injury ki nishani hai.

question.en: When are the ankle drawer and talar tilt tests most accurate?
question.ur: Ankle drawer aur talar tilt kab sab se durust hote hain?

feedback.en: They are clinical tests, not post-operative ones.
feedback.ur: Yeh clinical tests hain, surgery ke baad ke nahi.

feedback.en: Swelling and guarding hide laxity then.
feedback.ur: Tab sujan aur guarding laxity chhupa leti hain.

text.en: Four to five days after the injury, when swelling and guarding have settled
text.ur: Chot ke chaar paanch din baad, jab sujan aur guarding thami ho

feedback.en: Yes — a delayed examination is more accurate than one in the first hours.
feedback.ur: Haan — der se examination pehle ghanton se zyada durust hai.

text.en: **Load early.** For most lateral sprains, a short period of protection, then comfortable walking and early range, strengthening and balance exercise beats long immobilisation. Explain the plan, check again in a week, and look for a high ankle sprain if pain above the ankle is not settling.
text.ur: **Jaldi loading dein.** Zyada tar lateral sprains mein thori der hifazat, phir aaram se chalna aur jaldi range, strengthening aur balance exercise lambay immobilisation se behtar hai. Plan samjhayein, ek hafte baad dobara check karein, aur agar ankle ke oopar ka dard na thame to high ankle sprain dhoondein.

question.en: Why can a normal early ankle drawer test be misleading?
question.ur: Jaldi normal ankle drawer test ghalat fehmi kyun paida kar sakta hai?

answer.en: Because swelling, pain and muscle guarding in the first days can stop the ankle moving, hiding laxity. A test repeated four to five days later, when these settle, is more accurate.
answer.ur: Kyunke pehle dino mein sujan, dard aur muscle guarding ankle ko hilne se rokte hain aur laxity chhupa lete hain. Chaar paanch din baad jab yeh thamte hain to dohraya gaya test zyada durust hota hai.

beats.patient: A 19-year-old basketball player rolled her ankle two days ago. She can take four steps, has no bone tenderness over the malleoli, but pain and swelling at the front and outside of the ankle. The anterior drawer is guarded.
beats.assessment: The Ottawa rules are negative and the picture fits a lateral ligament sprain with guarding hiding laxity.
beats.treatment: Explain that a fracture is unlikely, start comfortable walking and early exercise, and repeat the drawer and talar tilt after four to five days.
beats.reassess: At day five the drawer shows mild laxity and a firm end-point: a grade two sprain; she returns to training over three weeks with balance work.

text.en: **Refer for imaging or urgent review** for any positive Ottawa finding, a deformed ankle, inability to take four steps, numbness or a cold, pale foot, a hot swollen ankle with fever, or calf pain and swelling that are out of proportion. A sudden calf "pop" with a positive Thompson test is a suspected Achilles rupture and needs the same-day referral.
text.ur: **Imaging ya urgent review ke liye refer karein** koi bhi positive Ottawa finding, badshakl ankle, chaar qadam na le pana, sunn hona ya thanda peela pair, bukhar ke saath garam sooja ankle, ya pindli ka beizafa dard aur sujan. Achanak pindli ka "pop" aur positive Thompson shak wale Achilles rupture ki nishani hai aur usi din referral chahiye.

summary.en: Use the Ottawa ankle rules first: bone tenderness at the back edge or tip of a malleolus, base of the fifth metatarsal or navicular, or inability to take four steps means an X-ray.
summary.ur: Pehle Ottawa ankle rules lagayein: malleolus ke peechay ke kinare ya nok, paanchve metatarsal ke base ya navicular par haddi ki tenderness, ya chaar qadam na le pana X-ray ka matlab hai.

summary.en: The anterior drawer tests the ATFL and the talar tilt the CFL; they are more accurate four to five days after the injury.
summary.ur: Anterior drawer ATFL aur talar tilt CFL ko test karta hai; chot ke chaar paanch din baad yeh zyada durust hote hain.

summary.en: Test the syndesmosis with the squeeze and external rotation tests (pain must be at the ankle); load a lateral sprain early and protect a high ankle sprain more.
summary.ur: Syndesmosis ko squeeze aur external rotation tests se test karein (dard ankle par hona chahiye); lateral sprain ko jaldi load karein aur high ankle sprain ko zyada hifazat dein.
